difficulty.rationale: Student must find the intersection bounds, identify the base side as x - x^2, recall the equilateral triangle area formula (√3/4)s^2, expand the squared binomial, and integrate with simple fractions (1/3 - 1/2 + 1/5 = 1/30) to get √3/120. Distractors target common errors: dropping the √3/4 factor and using a square cross section. Arithmetic is light and the wording is clear. Note: the item uses triangles, though the topic label says squares/rectangles; this is still within Unit 8 scope.
